REMOVAL AND DISASSEMBLY OF OIL PUMP

1. DRAIN ENGINE OIL

2. DRAIN COOLANT

3. REMOVE AIR CLEANER CASE

4. REMOVE AIR CONNECTOR PIPE WITH NO.1 AND NO.2 AIR CLEANER HOSES

5. REMOVE OIL LEVEL GAUGE

6. DISCONNECT UPPER RADIATOR HOSE

7. LOOSEN FAN BELTS
Loosen the belt adjusting bolts and nut of the PS pump and

8. REMOVE FOUR FAN SHROUD BOLTS
